goal_summary: Build FocusForge as an offline standard-library task and bug CLI with real CRUD, filtering, lifecycle, atomic JSON persistence, import/export, tests, and formal CGKN delivery evidence.

capability_gap.summary: The reviewed Provider run spent disproportionate requests, generated a generic import/export stage skeleton instead of the requested domain, and produced no executable candidate.

selected_items.summary: The Backend index contains 25 entries. Its manifest promises add/list/show/update/move/delete/summary/export/import, atomic storage, and domain behavior, but its published source interfaces expose a generic import/export stage pipeline instead of concrete task and bug command handlers.

backend/cli.py declares the requested command names, but _dispatch constructs ProjectOrchestrator([command], store). The orchestrator iterates stages and calls each stage, so a command string is treated as a callable and the command path cannot work.

ProjectOrchestrator.execute expects callable stages returning status/output mappings. It implements no WorkItem model, CRUD service, filter/sort behavior, lifecycle transition, or command dispatch contract.

The Tests librarian index is 133174 bytes and reflects an over-expanded 19-leaf test plan with anchor/part files. This is disproportionate to a medium standard-library CLI and repeatedly amplifies context and repair work.

failure_evidence.summary: The interrupted formal run made 87 Provider requests carrying 3036760 aggregate prompt characters. The Tests component alone made 70 requests carrying 2643437 prompt characters. The last event was another provider_request.
Canonical delivery status is NEEDS_REWORK with identity mismatches and non-passing runtime and test evidence. The public project has no executable assembled candidate.
